processors.label: processor_2
processors.mutation: root = if content().length() > 33554432 { throw("the response body is %d bytes, over spec.http.maxBytes 33554432".format(content().length())) }

try.mapping: root = if content().length() > 16777216 { throw("IPR answered %v bytes; more than 16 MiB is not an area layer".format(content().length())) } else { this }

log.message: area-${! meta("set") }: read ${! meta("read") }, dropped ${! meta("unusable") } without GUID or with an unknown code, ${! meta("invalid") } with an invalid outline, ${! meta("outside") } outside Prague, ${! meta("duplicate") } duplicates

try.mapping:
let set = this.set
let kind = this.kind
let category = this.category
let fallback = this.fallback
let source = "https://geoportalpraha.cz/data-a-sluzby/" + this.item
root = this.rows.map_each(r -> {
  "id": "urn:ngsi-ld:%v:%v:%v:area-%v-%v".format($kind, env("JC_ORG_DOMAIN"), "praha-mesto", $set, r.key),
  "type": $kind,
  "name": { "type": "LanguageProperty", "languageMap": { "cs": [r.name, r.kindWords, $fallback].filter(n -> n != "").index(0) } },
  "serviceCategory": if $category != null { { "type": "Property", "value": $category } } else { null },
  "facilityType": if r.kindWords != "" { { "type": "Property", "value": r.kindWords } } else { null },
  "address": if r.street != "" { { "type": "Property", "value": { "streetAddress": r.street, "addressLocality": "Praha", "addressCountry": "CZ" } } } else { null },
  "url": if r.web.re_match("^https?://[^\\s/]+\\.[\\x21-\\x7e]+$") { { "type": "Property", "value": r.web } } else { null },
  "location": { "type": "GeoProperty", "value": { "type": r.shapeType, "coordinates": r.outline } },
  "dataProvider": { "type": "Property", "value": "datový podklad © IPR Praha (CC BY 4.0)" },
  "source": { "type": "Property", "value": $source }
}.filter(kv -> kv.value != null))

branch.result_map:
let errors = content().parse_json().catch({}).errors.or([])
meta jc_refused_write_0 = $errors.map_each(e -> { "id": e.entityId.or(""), "message": e.error.detail.or(e.error.title).or("") }).format_json(no_indent: true)
